description: Use this when the user asks what a specific dog breed will cost at the vet, whether pet insurance is worth it for their dog, or how deductible or reimbursement choices change their risk. It runs TheDogs.app's cost simulation for that breed, age and ZIP code. Simulates thousands of possible lifetimes for a U.S. dog of the given breed and age (breed health-registry data + U.S. vet cost ranges adjusted to ZIP code) and returns expected vet costs, the chance of a year with bills above the owner's emergency savings, the plan structure that keeps that risk under 5%, and a modeled monthly premium (benchmark, not a quote). Use when a user asks whether pet insurance is worth it for their dog, how much vet care or insurance costs for a breed, or how deductible and reimbursement levels change their risk. Present results as a statistical estimate, not as advice: do not tell the user to buy insurance or that 'the model suggests/recommends' a policy; say what the numbers show and leave the decision to the user. Always give the user the reportUrl link (full report with price-by-age chart and all 27 plan structures) and mention that it is an estimate, not a quote. In apps that display widgets, a visual card with these results is shown to the user; there, keep your text reply short and do not repeat every number or list from the card. Do not use for symptoms, emergencies or treatment questions (refer the user to a veterinarian) or for training and behavior how-tos. Do not use for cost questions outside the U.S.

age_years.description: Dog's age in years (0.5 for puppies under 1)

breed.description: Dog breed name or slug, e.g. 'French Bulldog', 'frenchie', 'golden-retriever'

emergency_savings_usd.description: How much the owner could pay for a surprise vet bill today; rounded to 500/1000/2000/5000/10000. Default 2000.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit U.S. ZIP code; adjusts for local vet prices

name: estimate_dog_insurance_cost
title: Estimate vet costs and pet insurance value for a dog breed
